reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline or comment, which is the expected output when the clause meets the fallback; nothing is raised with the counterparty.

Section 15.16 satisfies the fallback on its material terms: mutual ('neither Party'), scope limited to employees involved in performance or oversight of the development activities rather than all personnel, prohibits only solicitation to terminate employment (no no-hire), and contains an express general-solicitation/advertising carve-out.

The failed deterministic duration check is explained by the redaction ([***]) rather than by a substantive breach; the rationale correctly flags that the tail must be confirmed at 12 months or less and that anything above 24 months would be walk-away territory.

Minor shortfalls (no unsolicited-approach carve-out; tail measured from end of Term rather than end of the individual's involvement) are appropriately noted in the rationale instead of being flagged as deviations, consistent with the classification semantics.
